name: Rhyme Stars ☆ Eros
original_name: らいむすたーず☆えろーす
source:
This is "Lamelo Land", a world full of magic and wonder. People lived peacefully there under the rule of a kind hearted goddess, but one day the sun suddenly grows dark, and the invasion of the Demon Army begins. Their purpose is to destroy the sun and open the gate to the Makai world. 
Now fairy with the blessing of the goddess descends to a courageous boy. Together they go on a journey to save the world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这就是“拉梅洛之地”，一个充满魔法和奇迹的世界。人们在一位善良女神的统治下过着平静的生活，但有一天，太阳突然变暗，恶魔大军的入侵开始了。他们的目的是摧毁太阳并打开通往魔界世界的大门。
现在仙女在女神的祝福下降临到了一个勇敢的男孩身上。他们一起踏上拯救世界的旅程。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
